01Overview

One place to find,plan and share.

Fishfinder is a mobile app concept for anglers. The experience brings location discovery, weather information, catch tracking, and a fishing community into one place.

The interface centres on the moments before, during, and after a trip: finding a spot, exploring nearby activity, and keeping a record of the catch.

02The challenge

Less searching.More time on
the water.

Finding the right fishing spot can take time. Busy schedules, unclear information, and equipment costs add friction to getting outdoors.

The design response

Make discovery the starting point. Connect the map, local activity, catch recording, and profile through a clear mobile journey.

DiscoverPlanShare

06Visual language

Rooted in water.Built for clarity.

A cool blue accent gives Fishfinder its identity. Light surfaces support content, while dark screens create contrast for onboarding and profiles.
